QuestInfo.name: [Commerci Republic] When You Need it Most
QuestInfo.0: All hope looked lost. Leon apologized for his recklessness, and you let it go. You focused on finding a way out of your predicament...
QuestInfo.1: All hope looked lost. Leon apologized for his recklessness, and you let it go. You focused on finding a way out of your predicament... Suddenly, you heard an explosion!
QuestInfo.2: All hope looked lost. Leon apologized for his recklessness, and you let it go. You focused on finding a way out of your predicament... Suddenly, you heard an explosion, and the Delfinos scattered. Out of the dust stepped the thief who stole the goods from the Daniella Merchant Union.
